pharmacology.text: NM-2-AI acts as a highly selective norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor and releasing agent in vitro and does not release serotonin or dopamine even at very high concentrations (100 μM). NM-2-AI has activity as a norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (IC50 = 2.4 μM), as well as acting as a TAAR1 receptor agonist (EC50 = 3.3 μM), an α2A adrenergic receptor agonist (Ki = 0.49 μM) and a ligand at the 5-HT1A (Ki = 3.6 μM) and 5-HT2A (Ki = 5.4 μM) receptors.

uses.text: NM-2-AI, or NM2AI, also known as N-methyl-2-aminoindane, is a stimulant of the 2-aminoindane family that has been sold online as a designer drug.
